content:
**Grilled Radtoad** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A Radtoad Leg which has been grilled over a fire. It gives a 30 minute boost to Carry Weight while restoring a small amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a negligible dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Radtoad Leg (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Radtoad Leg | | Grilled Radtoad (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after picking up a Radtoad Leg for the first time.
